title: DNS resolution issue
symptoms: DNS not working hostname cannot resolve website name lookup failure
summary: A device may be unable to translate hostnames into IP addresses.
steps: Confirm whether the issue affects one device or multiple users.
Check network connectivity to the configured DNS server.
Review the device DNS configuration and VPN/GSA connection state.
Use nslookup for a known hostname and record the DNS server shown.
Compare results with a working device; do not change DNS settings without approval.
escalate: DNS server unreachable, widespread failures, or suspected DNS record/configuration changes.

title: Network connectivity issue
symptoms: internet not working network disconnected cannot access network
summary: Connectivity may be affected by the adapter, local network, gateway, or upstream service.
steps: Check whether Wi-Fi/Ethernet is connected and whether other users are affected.
Confirm the device has a valid IP address, gateway, and DNS configuration.
Test reachability to the default gateway before testing external destinations.
Check VPN/GSA status and recent network changes.
Capture timestamps and error messages for troubleshooting.
escalate: Multiple users/sites are affected, gateway is unreachable, or an outage is suspected.

title: Printer issue
symptoms: printer not printing offline print queue stuck
summary: Printing may be blocked by printer connectivity, queue, driver, or spooler state.
steps: Confirm printer power, paper, toner, and displayed error.
Check whether the issue affects one user or everyone using the printer.
Verify printer connectivity and the selected printer/queue.
Review pending jobs; clear jobs only after confirming with the user.
Record the printer name, error, and time of failure.
escalate: Hardware fault, shared queue outage, or repeated driver/spooler failures.

title: Microsoft 365 sign-in issue
symptoms: microsoft 365 login sign in outlook teams authentication error
summary: Sign-in failures can relate to account status, MFA, device compliance, Conditional Access, or service health.
steps: Record the exact error code and correlation/request ID if shown.
Check whether the issue occurs in browser, desktop app, or mobile app.
Confirm device date/time and network connectivity.
Review Microsoft 365 service health and approved identity troubleshooting logs.
Do not ask the user to share passwords or MFA codes.
escalate: Repeated authentication failures, Conditional Access blocks, suspected account compromise, or tenant-wide impact.
